description: This file defines the RGraph.Gantt class, a JavaScript implementation for rendering Gantt charts on HTML5 canvas elements. It includes methods for configuration, drawing, event handling, and visual effects specific to Gantt charts within the RGraph charting library.

classes.name: RGraph.Gantt
classes.description: Constructor for creating Gantt chart instances within the RGraph library, supporting configuration, rendering, and interaction features.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property or multiple properties via an object for configuration.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified property.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the Gantt chart on the canvas, including background, labels, events, and interactivity.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a provided function in the context of the chart object, enabling method chaining.

methods.name: drawLabels
methods.description: Draws the top and side labels for the chart.

methods.name: drawEvents
methods.description: Draws the Gantt events, bars, and related visual elements.

methods.name: getShape
methods.description: Returns shape information if a mouse event is over a bar.

methods.name: getBar
methods.description: Returns the bar shape under the mouse event.

methods.name: drawSingleEvent
methods.description: Draws an individual Gantt event bar with optional labels and completion indicators.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights a shape (e.g., bar) on the chart.

methods.name: getObjectByXY
methods.description: Returns the chart object if the mouse coordinates are within its bounds.

methods.name: adjusting_mousemove
methods.description: Handles mouse movement for adjusting (moving/resizing) bars.

methods.name: positionTooltip
methods.description: Positions a tooltip element relative to a chart shape.

methods.name: getXCoord
methods.description: Calculates the X coordinate on the chart for a given data value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the data value corresponding to mouse position or event.

methods.name: parseColors
methods.description: Parses and prepares color gradients for rendering.

methods.name: parseSingleColorForGradient
methods.description: Parses a color string, creating a gradient if specified.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Adds an event listener to the chart object.

methods.name: firstDrawFunc
methods.description: Placeholder for a function to run after the first draw.

methods.name: grow
methods.description: Animates the chart with a grow effect.

methods.name: resetColorsToOriginalValues
methods.description: Resets colors to their original values.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the chart to its initial state.
